svg.text: An agent drives a seasonal-forecast workflow, and the benchmark checks every step
A real run: gpt-6-luna, seasonal rainfall calibration to the WMO guidance, a box in Kenya, trained on 1993–2004, outlook for 2005–2006. 60 s, 57,843 tokens.
Totals in mm, on the forecast grid

The WMO checklist, 11 steps, each from the most exact evidence
Recorded: 60 s, 57,843 tokens, model, harness, substrate,
input and artifact hashes, the tool trace, the judge id.
The other attempt on this box that day failed: its boundaries included the held-out year.
Same task, same data, same checks for every system. Change the model, the harness, the substrate or the supplied material, and compare pass rate, cost and time.
A second episode hands this submission to the same system for another box, another season or the next task.

Terms: a probe reruns the agent's code on changed data; a pitfall is a known wrong method with a computable wrong answer; the reference is controller code that computes the answer under every defensible reading of the brief.
